evidence_quote: Raku firing: The raku firing process involves heating the pottery piece in a kiln to a high temperature, typically around 1000-1050 degrees Celsius (1850-1900F), and then quickly removing it from the kiln and placing it in a container filled with combustible material such as sawdust or straw.
summary: Join an afternoon raku firing on October 30, 2026. Bring up to 8 bisqued pieces. Current students pay $28; others pay $70 per session.
